title: 3rd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/3/2024).
First reading of the Bill to amend the Maldives Immigration Act (Law No. 1/2007), submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem.
From the Speaker's desk: appointing a Member of Parliament to the Clemency Board, as required under Article 11 of the Clemency Act (Law No. 2/2010).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission on appointing Maldives ambassadors to foreign countries, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021).

From the Speaker's desk: the President has returned the 9th Amendment Bill to the Maldives Land Act (Law No. 1/2002), which Parliament passed and sent for ratification under Article 91(a) of the Constitution, for reconsideration.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to introduce an immigration law amendment and take up a Clemency Board seat, ambassador appointments, and a Land Act amendment the President sent back.
